title: Perfect source models on affine opens
statement: For a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], a perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex] quasi-coherent derived object E [def-pc-derived-category], and an affine open U, let A=Gamma(U,O_X), and R be derived over-site restriction. For every functor F:D(A) -> D(O_X over U) equipped with a natural comparison Q followed by F isomorphic to Q of termwise affinePerfectSheafification [lem-pc-affine-perfect-module-model], there exists a bounded complex P of finite projective A-modules with F(Q(P)) isomorphic to R(E). No target object, support hypothesis, torsion assertion, or scalar identity is part of this statement.

source.place: Tags 08EB and 06Z0; affine paragraph of Tag 08EJ

proof.text:
Use open_derived_restriction_comparison to restrict the quasi-coherent source
and to choose localizations on the open subscheme. Intersect each strictly perfect
neighbourhood of E with U. Exact restriction preserves the bounds and finite-free
retract equations, so the restricted source is perfect. Transport it through
U.toScheme ≅ Spec Gamma(U,O_X); this preserves perfectness by transporting the same
open neighbourhoods, complexes, bounds and retract equations. Apply
perfect_iff_affine_bounded_projective to obtain P and its bounded finite-projective
terms. The affine_localized_site_derived_transport comparison identifies its tilde
model on the spectrum with Q of affinePerfectSheafification(P). The given natural
comparison at P then gives the required isomorphism. The empty open has zero section
ring, and the same argument applies to its zero category. No support or scalar
compatibility is asserted here.

lean.statement: theorem affine_open_perfect_source_model (X : Scheme.{u}) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] [∀ U : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))] (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) (hE : X.IsPerfect E.obj) (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) : let A := ↑(X.sheaf.obj.obj (op U)) letI : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ModuleCat.{u} A) := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} A) let R := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory ∀ (F : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) ⥤ DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))), Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ F ≅ (affinePerfectSheafification X U hU).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q) → ∃ P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → IsZero (P.X i)) ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite A (P.X i)) ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Projective A (P.X i)) ∧ Nonempty (F.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≅ R.obj E.obj)
